title: A near-miss none routed split still tells the reader not to answer from its hits
goal: A none pack that routes split (a near miss) prints the facts and source footer a weak pack would, without the none sentence that forbids answering from its hits, so the kb: hook and kb_ask.py's split reader can answer the part the kb has (the sp_getapplock lines with @LockTimeout = 0 and sp_releaseapplock); TestRoute asserts it for the h2_applock question.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;r=kbfacts.pack('Show T-SQL that takes an exclusive session-owned application lock without waiting, fails if it is held, and releases it.');t=r['text'] if isinstance(r,dict) else r;assert 'Do not answer from the hits' not in t,t[:300]
